notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only the NHLR entry and the FFLA list were usable; the Forest Lookouts Birdnest page has a header and no body text. No build date, height or design found. The 2009 report's 'aerometer' is probably Aermotor but is not stated, so no design is recorded. 'Unstaffed' comes from visit-report impressions in 2017, not an agency record. The newest visit is from 2017, so current condition and standing are unverified. Access is not stated by any source read. Record elevation_m 10.1 matches 33 ft. A web search snippet mentioned a Franktown location and a 2008 status note; no page was read to confirm it, so it is not used.
